title: Redirect Rule Input
summary: Catches redirect rules that loop, chain, shadow each other, open-redirect, drop queries or switch POST to GET, modelled on how each platform matches.
description: Redirect list checker for vercel.json, Netlify _redirects and nginx rewrite/return. Finds loops, chains, shadowed rules, open redirects, wrong status codes, dropped queries and trailing-slash traps, with a GET/POST tester and one-tap fixes.
catches: Loops and 2+ hop chains, with the hop path
Rules shadowed by an earlier wildcard
Open redirects whose destination host comes from the request
301/308 on temporary moves and 301/302 turning POST into GET
Dropped query strings, ?query or #hash in the source, missing leading slash, unmatched placeholders
Trailing-slash traps and hops to http
limits: Models each platform from its docs; framework middleware, headers/has conditions and server config elsewhere are not evaluated
nginx support covers rewrite/return and location selection, not every module or include
Open-redirect detection is pattern-based; review any destination built from user input
a11y: Visible <label> on the textarea; aria-invalid when errors exist and status wired via aria-describedby
Issue count is a role=status region
GET/POST tester is a roving-tabindex radiogroup operated with arrow keys
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix button or back to the textarea
Hop outcomes shown with icons and text
server: Validate redirect destinations against an allowlist on the server; this checks config text, not live traffic.

rules.note: Confirmed on Vercel (permanent defaults to true = 308, source is case-sensitive) and Netlify (default 301, 307 unsupported, query passed for 200/301/302, trailing slash ignored when matching). nginx behaviour not re-checked this round. Platforms change; check their docs.
